neighbours.label: ' situ' in 'in situ' (measured in place)
fire: The crystal growth was monitored in situ with an X-ray beam.
Researchers measured soil moisture in situ at forty field plots.
The catalyst was activated in situ before the reaction began.
Carcinoma in situ means the abnormal cells have not spread.
We used an in-situ probe to record the water temperature at depth.
The bridge was repaired in situ rather than being moved to a workshop.
Strain in the film was tracked in situ during heating.
The mosaic was conserved in situ by a team of restorers.
quiet: The crystal growth was monitored with an X-ray beam afterwards.
Researchers measured soil moisture in the lab using samples from forty plots.
The catalyst was activated in vitro before the reaction began.
Carcinoma in its early stage often causes no symptoms.
We used a long probe to record the water temperature at depth.
The bridge was moved to a workshop to be repaired.
Strain in the film was tracked in vivo during heating.
The mosaic was lifted and conserved by a team of restorers.

notes: probe: 'in situ' 0.23, 'in place' 0.10, 'in vitro' 0.02. Other top examples (sample stage, time lapse) not covered.
